title: verify: folded header lines not unfolded before x_sig verification
description: In x_sig.rs, the X-Stoa-Sig header value is extracted as-is. RFC 5322 allows header values to be folded across multiple lines (CRLF + whitespace). A folded X-Stoa-Sig header will have the fold embedded in the base64, causing verification to fail for otherwise valid signatures.
